findings.evidence: New behavior: `pkg/ddl/syncer/syncer.go:497` does `etcdCli.Get(ctx, s.jobNodeVerPrefix, WithPrefix())` where `jobNodeVerPrefix = util.DDLAllSchemaVersionsByJob + "/"` (`pkg/ddl/syncer/syncer.go:231-233`), so it loads *all* `/tidb/ddl/all_schema_by_job_versions/<job>/<tidb>` keys and watches the whole prefix (`pkg/ddl/syncer/syncer.go:516-520`). Keys are written without lease under MDL via `PutKVToEtcdMono` (`pkg/ddl/syncer/syncer.go:320-333`). Cleanup is gated by `job.State == model.JobStateSynced` at call sites (`pkg/ddl/job_table.go:446`, `pkg/ddl/job_table.go:484`) and in `cleanMDLInfo` (`pkg/ddl/ddl_worker.go:654-660`); rollback/cancel paths don’t set `JobStateSynced` (`pkg/ddl/ddl_worker.go:943-946`, `pkg/ddl/ddl_worker.go:977-981`). Second confirmation (behavior change vs parent): previous MDL path only `Get`-ed `/.../<jobID>/` (`parent 1c4a9c6434 pkg/ddl/syncer/syncer.go:299-329`), so stale keys for other jobs didn’t amplify cost.
findings.fix: Preferably delete `/tidb/ddl/all_schema_by_job_versions/<jobID>/` once a job reaches any terminal state that no longer needs MDL coordination (at least `RollbackDone`/`Cancelled` in addition to `Synced`), after the final schema-version/MDL sync point. If deletion-on-terminal is hard, scope the watch/cache to only currently-waited jobIDs (on-demand watch per jobID) or attach an expiry/lease strategy for per-job keys to prevent unbounded retention.
findings.impact: With the new full-prefix cache, any leftover per-job keys (e.g., rollback-done/cancelled jobs or transient cleanup failures) accumulate under the watched prefix and are loaded/cached cluster-wide. Over time this can bloat etcd response sizes and in-memory `jobNodeVersions`, increasing startup/retry cost and risking `SyncJobSchemaVerLoop` churn or failure, which can in turn stall MDL-based `OwnerCheckAllVersions` and block DDL progress.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed as of `upstream/master` (f0813a3696…): `upstream/master:pkg/ddl/job_scheduler.go#L684` still has the TODO and only deletes when `job.State == model.JobStateSynced`; the full-prefix Get/Watch remains in `upstream/master:pkg/ddl/schemaver/syncer.go#L497`.
findings.verify: 1) Enable MDL, create terminal jobs that end in `RollbackDone`/`Cancelled`, then check etcd for lingering `/tidb/ddl/all_schema_by_job_versions/<jobID>/` keys. 2) Accumulate many such job prefixes and confirm `SyncJobSchemaVerLoop` initial `Get` remains bounded (no oversized responses), and that owner-side `OwnerCheckAllVersions` still completes under load.
findings.what: `SyncJobSchemaVerLoop` now performs a full-prefix etcd `Get`/`Watch` over `/tidb/ddl/all_schema_by_job_versions/` and caches all job-version keys, but the code only deletes these keys for `JobStateSynced` jobs. Terminal rollback/cancel paths (and any deletion failures) can leave per-job keys behind indefinitely, making the watched keyspace and cache unbounded over time and risking MDL schema-sync stalls or resource blowups.

subject: ddl: sync schema version using watch, notify sessions on owner node by job id (#53217)
summary: Commit introduces per-job DDL completion notifications and an etcd-watch-based cache for MDL job schema-version syncing. High risk: the new full-prefix job-version cache can grow without bound if per-job keys aren’t reliably cleaned for non-`Synced` terminal outcomes, potentially impacting MDL-based DDL progress and resource usage.
